tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The connected creator's public profile: name, username, storefront URL, currency.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the creator's products (newest first). Returns id, name, price, published state, whether it is a bundle, and URL.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Fetch one product by id or permalink, with its description and covers, and the products a bundle sells. The first cover is the main one.

tools.name: create_draft_product
tools.title: Create draft product
tools.description: Create a draft digital product, or a draft membership with tiers billed on a recurring period. It is not for sale until publish_product runs. Confirm the name and prices with the creator first.

price_cents.description: Price in minor units (cents for USD). Use 0 for a free product. Required for a digital product; not accepted for a membership, whose prices are set on its tiers.

tiers.description: Membership tiers, in display order. Required for a membership, not accepted otherwise. Every tier must use the same recurrence.

price_cents.description: Price per billing period in minor units of the creator's currency. 0 makes the tier pay what you want.

tools.name: update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: Change the name, description, price, or URL of an existing product. Pass only the fields to change. The new description replaces the old one. Confirm the changes with the creator first.

price_cents.description: New price in minor units of the product's currency. Not available for memberships with tiers.

permalink.description: New URL slug, the part after /l/. Letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores only. The old URL keeps working. Send an empty string to go back to the default URL.

tools.name: add_cover
tools.title: Add cover
tools.description: Add a cover image or video to a product from a public URL. The first cover is the main one on the product page.

url.description: Public https URL of an image, or a YouTube or Vimeo link.

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: The files a buyer receives with this product: name, type, size, and position. The download page lists them in this order.

tools.name: add_file
tools.title: Add file
tools.description: Add a file that buyers receive with the product, from a public https URL. Files up to 250 MB; larger files, like a long video, must be uploaded in the product editor. Ask the creator for the link if they have not given one.

url.description: Public https URL of the file.

display_name.description: Name shown to the buyer. Defaults to the name in the URL.

tools.name: publish_product
tools.title: Publish product
tools.description: Make a draft product purchasable. Confirm with the creator first.

tools.name: unpublish_product
tools.title: Unpublish product
tools.description: Take a product off sale without deleting it.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: Successful sales, newest first, with net amount, fees, country, discount code, affiliate commission, referrer and UTM fields. Free downloads count as sales; use payment=paid to skip them. When next_cursor is returned, pass it as cursor for the next page.

product_id.description: Only sales of this product (id from list_products).

after.description: Only sales on or after this date or ISO 8601 time (UTC), e.g. 2026-10-01.

before.description: Only sales before this date or ISO 8601 time (UTC), e.g. 2026-11-01.

payment.description: paid = price above zero, free = zero-price sales.

kind.description: subscription = membership charges, one_time = everything else.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.title: Get analytics
tools.description: Product page views, sales and revenue for a date range, so conversion rate (sales / views) can be computed. breakdown=product (default) gives one row per product; breakdown=referrer gives views, sales and revenue per traffic source. Revenue is price minus refunds and chargebacks, before fees, in minor units of USD. Dates are in the creator's time zone and default to the last 30 days.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 29 days before end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_customers
tools.title: Get customers
tools.description: Buyer-level sales for the creator's store, one row per buyer email. breakdown=spend (default) gives orders count, spend, refunded and charged-back amounts, and first and last order dates per buyer; breakdown=conversion gives buyers whose first purchase was free and who later paid, with days to convert. Amounts are price before fees in minor units of USD, with refunds and chargebacks reported on their own lines; start_date and end_date are days in the creator's time zone that bound order dates, or the purchase that converted.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the creator's time zone. Omit for all time.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Omit for all time.

tools.name: get_sales_totals
tools.title: Get sales totals
tools.description: Revenue, units and average order value for a date range, grouped by product, country or period. Counts sales that still stand: successful or preorder-authorized sales not refunded or charged back, free downloads included. Revenue is price before fees, in minor units of USD, and average_order_value_cents is revenue_cents divided by units. Dates are in the creator's time zone and default to the last 30 days. Product and country rows are the top 100 by revenue.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 29 days before end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

breakdown.description: product (default), country, day, week or month. A period row's date is the day, the Monday of the week, or the first of the month, in the creator's time zone.

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.title: Get subscriptions
tools.description: The creator's memberships and their state. breakdown=subscriptions (default) gives one row per subscription, newest first, with status, start date, cancel date and failed payments; breakdown=churn gives one row per month with the subscriber base, the subscribers who left and the churn rate, from the same source as the dashboard. Test subscriptions are excluded. Subscription timestamps are in UTC; churn dates are in the creator's time zone.

limit.description: Max subscriptions to return (1-50, default 25). breakdown=subscriptions only.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. breakdown=subscriptions only.

status.description: alive = still delivering content, including subscriptions set to cancel at the end of the period; ended = it has stopped (cancelled, failed, deactivated or its period ended). Omit for both. breakdown=subscriptions only.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the start of the month 11 months before end_date. breakdown=churn only.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. breakdown=churn only.

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: Recent payouts to the creator's bank or PayPal.

tools.name: create_bundle
tools.title: Create bundle
tools.description: Create a draft bundle: one product that sells several of the creator's own products together at the bundle's own price. It is not for sale until publish_product runs. Confirm the products and the price with the creator first.

price_cents.description: Price of the bundle in minor units (cents for USD). It is not derived from the products it contains; use 0 for a free bundle.

product_ids.description: Ids or permalinks of the creator's products the bundle sells, in the order they should appear. A product sold in versions is added at its first version.

tools.name: update_bundle
tools.title: Update bundle
tools.description: Replace the products a bundle sells. The bundle keeps its name, price, description, and published state; use update_product for the name, price, or description, and publish_product or unpublish_product for its state. Confirm the new list with the creator first.

product_ids.description: Ids or permalinks of the creator's products the bundle should sell, in the order they should appear. This list replaces the bundle's current products. A product the bundle already sells keeps its version and quantity.

tools.name: create_discount_code
tools.title: Create discount code
tools.description: Create a discount code for all of the creator's products, or for one product. Pass exactly one of percent_off or amount_cents. Confirm the code, the amount, and which products it covers with the creator first, and call this once per confirmation: an existing code is refused, not duplicated.

code.description: The code buyers enter. Letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.

product_id.description: Product id or permalink. Omit for a code that covers all of the creator's products.

amount_cents.description: Fixed amount off in minor units of the product's currency (the creator's currency for an all-products code). Not with percent_off.

valid_at.description: ISO 8601 time the code starts working. If only expires_at is given, the start is now for a new code and unchanged for an existing one.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time the code stops working.

max_purchase_count.description: How many times the code can be used in total. 0 or more.

tools.name: update_discount_code
tools.title: Update discount code
tools.description: Change the amount, dates, or usage limit of an existing discount code. Pass only the fields to change. A code that covers several products changes for all of them. Confirm the changes with the creator first.

product_id.description: Product id or permalink, for a code made for specific products. Omit for a code that covers all products.

amount_cents.description: Fixed amount off in minor units of the product's currency (the creator's currency for an all-products code). Not with percent_off.

valid_at.description: ISO 8601 time the code starts working. If only expires_at is given, the start is now for a new code and unchanged for an existing one.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time the code stops working.

max_purchase_count.description: How many times the code can be used in total. 0 or more.

tools.name: expire_discount_code
tools.title: Expire discount code
tools.description: End a discount code now so buyers can no longer use it. The code is kept and shows as expired; update_discount_code with a later expires_at reopens it. Expiring a code that has already expired changes nothing and succeeds. Confirm with the creator first.

product_id.description: Product id or permalink, for a code made for specific products. Omit for a code that covers all products.
